description: Detects a Python interpreter spawning another Python interpreter whose command line references a randomly-named file in the Temp directory, matching the NamedTemporaryFile loader used by trojanized PyPI packages (Snyk Fetch-the-Flag pay-attention / pytest 7.1.3).

    Image|endswith:

    CommandLine|contains: '\Temp\tmp'

  - https://snyk.io/blog/npm-security-malicious-code-in-oss-npm-packages/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/30
tags:

detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:

| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")

title: Semicolon Query-Parameter Cloaking (Web Cache Poisoning)
id: 6f3b2c14-9d5a-4e77-b1c8-2a4f7e0d9c31
status: experimental
description: Detects inbound HTTP requests using a semicolon as a query-parameter separator, the parameter-cloaking primitive behind CVE-2021-23336 (Python parse_qsl) and CVE-2020-28473 (Bottle) web cache poisoning.
references:
  - https://snyk.io/blog/cache-poisoning-in-open-source-packages/
  - https://python-security.readthedocs.io/vuln/urllib-query-string-semicolon-separator.html
  - https://security.snyk.io/vuln/SNYK-PYTHON-BOTTLE-1017108
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/08
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-uri-query|re: ';[A-Za-z0-9_.\-]{1,40}='
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legacy applications that legitimately use ';' as a query separator
  - Matrix parameters such as ;jsessionid=
